classification.difficultyReason: An L-shape with mixed m and cm labels. The student converts units and then either finds the two missing sides or uses the bounding-rectangle shortcut. Routine linked procedures, with no search or reframing.

content.prompt: Find the perimeter of this shape. Answer in m.

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}150\text{ cm}&=1.5\text{ m}\\250\text{ cm}&=2.5\text{ m}\\\text{Inner horizontal side}&=6-2.5=3.5\text{ m}\\\text{Inner vertical side}&=4-1.5=2.5\text{ m}\\P&=6+1.5+3.5+2.5+2.5+4\\P&=20\text{ m}\end{align*}$$
